environment.command: python -m benchmarks.run --quick --workloads images --workers 1 2 --batches 1 4 --backends thread process --output benchmarks/results/real-world-images.json

scope: Single host, local generated fixtures, original workload replicas; no upstream interoperability or deployment certification.

method.selection: Minimum calibration cold construction+execution plus warm execution; same search grid for both engines
method.warm: Second pass in same pool; fresh application fixtures/cache; OS/library caches uncontrolled
method.memory: 10 ms sampled absolute aggregate process-tree RSS including fixture server, shared pages may double-count
method.intelligent: Explicit thread/process hints with predictive admission; not automatic backend selection
method.comparison: Held-out time of calibration-selected stdlib divided by separately calibration-selected intelligent; no held-out oracle tuning

convergence.reason: Two pool passes measure cold/warm behavior, not statistical policy convergence.
